name: Terazosin Hydrochloride

fda.text: Syncope and “First-dose” Effect Terazosin capsules, like other alpha-adrenergic blocking agents, can cause marked lowering of blood pressure, especially postural hypotension, and syncope in association with the first dose or first few days of therapy. A similar effect can be anticipated if therapy is interrupted for…

summary: A small computer model, not testing on real people, estimated a medium risk score of 62 for the liver and a low risk score of 38 for the heart [M]. An official warning notes that Terazosin capsules can cause a significant drop in blood pressure, particularly postural hypotension, which is a fall in blood pressure upon standing up [3]. This drop, along with syncope, meaning fainting, is linked to the first dose or the first few days of taking the medicine [3]. A similar fainting and low blood pressure effect can also be expected if treatment is paused [3].
